Cork Diary A5 Notebook and Notepad (Pro) – Eco-Friendly Premium Stationery

Upgrade your writing experience with the Cork Diary A5 Notebook and Notepad (Pro), crafted with sustainable materials and a premium finish for professionals, students, and environmentally conscious users. This eco-friendly A5 size notebook is designed to offer elegance, comfort, and durability while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. With its 192 pages (80gsm) of high-quality ruled sheets, this diary provides a smooth writing flow for daily notes, journaling, planning, and office use.

The highlight of the cork cover is its natural texture and soft-touch feel, making the Cork Diary A5 Notebook and Notepad (Pro) a stylish and responsible stationery option. Cork is a renewable resource, harvested without harming trees, making this notebook an ideal choice for anyone looking for eco-friendly stationery and sustainable office supplies. Whether used for corporate gifting, personal planning, or daily productivity, this notebook stands out with its unique material and elegant aesthetics.

Equipped with an integrated pen holder, this A5 ruled notebook ensures you never misplace your pen again—perfect for meetings, travel, and on-the-go writing. The premium finish and ergonomic construction make it an excellent choice for organizations looking for thoughtful corporate gifts, employee welcome kits, conference giveaways, or branded merchandise. Its design reflects modern minimalism paired with eco-friendly values, appealing to contemporary audiences who value sustainability and style.

Whether you need a compact notepad for everyday use, a sustainable writing companion, or a high-quality diary for gifting, the delivers on both performance and aesthetics. With ample writing space, smooth pages, and durable binding, it remains a trusted choice among professionals, educators, and creative users. The fits easily in backpacks, laptop bags, and office folders, making it convenient for business travel and academic use.

Key Features

  • Eco-Friendly Design: Crafted from sustainable cork materials for an environmentally responsible choice.
  • A5 Size Format: Compact, portable, and ideal for daily use at home, school, or office.
  • 192 Pages (80gsm): High-quality ruled pages suitable for smooth and bleed-free writing.
  • Cork Cover: Durable, lightweight, and naturally textured for a premium feel.
  • Integrated Pen Holder: Keeps your pen secure and accessible at all times.

This blends eco-conscious craftsmanship with modern design, making it a versatile addition to your stationery collection. Whether you’re documenting ideas, planning schedules, or gifting thoughtfully, this ensures style and function come together seamlessly. Its soft cork texture, sturdy binding, and practical features offer a reliable writing experience for everyday use.

Add this to your workspace today and enjoy a comfortable, organized, and writing companion.
